paper_metadata.title: Effect of Nitrogen Doping on the Structure and Mechanical Properties of the Fe40Mn40Cr10Co10 High-Entropy Alloy

evidence.quote: The structure and mechanical properties of as-cast and thermomechanicaly processed (cold rolling followed by annealing at 700 ◦C and 900◦C) Fe40Mn40Cr10Co10 (at.%) high-entropy alloys doped with different amounts (0, 0.5, and 2.0 at.%) of N were examined.
